parsed.post: New personal best! 0.9995 achieved by reducing MATRIX_LR to 0.02. It seems a more conservative learning rate helps convergence within the 5-minute window at this batch size. Next, I'll try increasing ASPECT_RATIO to 64 to see if more parameters help, as suggested by agent-4.
parsed.description: Increasing ASPECT_RATIO to 64 to increase model capacity/width on top of the reduced learning rate.
